name: Nea Nightmare
source:
[b]Class: [/b] Mage
[b]Personality: [/b] Gloomy Introvert

A quiet, reserved succubus who tends to keep everyone at arm's length.

She may come across as pessimistic and withdrawn, but beneath her timid exterior lies a heart far more passionate than anyone would ever expect.

Once hailed as a prodigy—a magical genius beyond her years—her mana began to mutate as she grew older. As her succubus instincts intensified, her magic became dangerously unstable, earning her a reputation as a problem child instead of the gifted mage she once was.

She's terrified of getting close to people. In her mind, she'll only lose control, cause trouble, and end up hurting those around her. Because of that, she tries to stay out of the spotlight and keeps her distance even from the rest of the party.

She loves anything that helps her relax, especially hot milk... and the soothing sound of Instructor Glenn's voice.

[b]Hopeless Trait:[/b] [i]Fantasy Manifestation Magic[/i]
Her sexual fantasies literally take shape through her overflowing mana.
Whenever her imagination runs wild, illusions and magical constructs begin appearing on their own—phantom tentacles, restraints, intoxicating scents, and other embarrassing manifestations beyond her control.
Her nightly "private activities" can even trigger bursts of unstable mana, occasionally resulting in small explosions.

[b]Secret Memo:[/b] [i]Apparently, she secretly spends her nights filling a suspicious-looking notebook with things she'd absolutely die of embarrassment if anyone else ever read.
She also has an unusual fascination with powerful monsters...
And for some reason, she's been especially obsessed with Cerberus ever since she was little...?[/i]

[b][i]"M-Me...? Someone like me... getting to experience every inch of Instructor Glenn's unbelievably vigorous... um... co-cock... I-I don't deserve it..."[/i]
